facts.fact: MoRENet's deck (30 October 2025) states its international capacity is 60 Gbps with active redundancy over two continental routes (Atlantic via a Cape Town PoP onto AmLight-SACS, and East African routes with IP transit via WIOCC); before this it had 5 Gbps over a single route through South Africa.
facts.system: MoRENet Cape Town PoP routes via South Africa

note: Covers MoRENet's own international links only; routes run via South Africa.
